sections.h2: A local painting contractor for the city of Alachua
body: Alachua is both a county and a city, and this page is about the city: the town around Historic Main Street, ZIP code 32615, up on the north side of the county. If you're looking for painters in Alachua, FL, Precision Paint Experts is a locally owned contractor based in nearby Newberry. We're licensed, bonded, and fully insured in Florida, and every person on your property is part of our own crew. We don't subcontract.
With 15+ years of painting in North Central Florida, we know which finishes survive a wet August here. For the wider county, see our Alachua County service page.

sections.h2: Main Street, Progress Park, and the big lots up north
body: Alachua has a wider mix of buildings than its size suggests. Older storefronts line Historic Main Street, where the trim, signboards, and street-facing facades are what people see first. The Progress Park corridor brings in commercial buildings that need repaints planned around working hours. Outside the center you'll find newer subdivisions like Turkey Creek, Cinnamon Hills, Heritage Oaks, and Savannah Station. Farther north there are large-lot homes with long fence lines, wide decks, and detached outbuildings.

People here care about curb appeal, and each property type needs different prep. Storefront trim needs careful scraping and spot-priming. Subdivision homes often have to stay within community color rules. On acreage, we're often staining as much wood as we paint.

sections.h2: What Alachua weather does to paint
body: Summer humidity here stays above 75% for months, and from June into September afternoon storms arrive three or four days a week. Walls that face south and west take the strongest UV all year. Put those together and you get the failures we see most often: chalky siding that leaves powder on your palm, peeling along the bottom of fascia and door frames, widening stucco hairlines, and color that has bleached out on the sunny sides while the north wall still looks fine.

A coating here is a weather barrier first. That's why we put 100% acrylic on siding and trim, elastomeric on stucco that has hairline movement, and penetrating stain on bare wood. Our article on why humidity makes paint peel explains the mechanics.

sections.h2: How a project in Alachua runs
body: It starts with a walkthrough, usually scheduled within 48 hours. A crew lead, not a salesperson, measures, photographs each elevation, and takes moisture readings where wood or stucco looks suspect. The itemized written estimate usually arrives within one business day and names the surfaces, prep steps, products, number of coats, and schedule. Nothing is added later without your written approval.

Most jobs start one to three weeks after approval. Prep days come first: washing, scraping, mildew treatment, rotted fascia replacement, re-caulking, and spot-priming. Then come two full coats, plus a third for dramatic color changes. The job closes with a punch walk you sign, and anything that isn't right gets fixed before we leave. Exteriors carry a written workmanship warranty of up to 10 years.

sections.h2: Towns near Alachua we also serve
body: Our crews regularly work in the towns around Alachua. To the northwest, High Springs has craftsman homes and clapboard. To the south, Newberry is where we're based. To the southeast, Gainesville painting projects make up one of our two largest markets. If your property sits between towns or outside city limits, ask for a free quote and we'll confirm coverage.

faqs.q: Do you work in the city of Alachua or just Alachua County?
faqs.a: Both. This page covers the city of Alachua (ZIP 32615), including Historic Main Street, the Progress Park corridor, and neighborhoods like Turkey Creek and Savannah Station. We also serve Gainesville, Newberry, High Springs, Archer, Hawthorne, and Micanopy in the same county.

faqs.q: How quickly can someone look at my Alachua property?
faqs.a: Walkthroughs are usually scheduled within 48 hours, and the written estimate usually follows within one business day. Most projects start one to three weeks after you approve the estimate.

faqs.q: When is the best time to paint an exterior in Alachua?
faqs.a: October through May, when humidity drops and afternoon storms are less frequent. We still paint exteriors in summer, but crews start early and keep an eye on dew point and radar. Interior work can happen any time of year.

faqs.q: Are your painters licensed and insured?
faqs.a: Yes. We're licensed, bonded, and fully insured in Florida, with workers' comp on every crew member. Commercial clients and HOAs can get a certificate of insurance naming their entity before work begins.
